testing_warning: This build is published so the website, release manifest, downloads, checksums, and Android install path can be tested. It is not yet confirmed as the first fully working wallet release. Do not use it for meaningful funds.

copy.hero_title: Pearl Wallet for Android is being tested.
copy.hero_summary: PRL Wallet is a noncustodial Android wallet project for Pearl. This page is wired to release metadata so every build can update the version, date, download link, hash, changelog, and status without editing the homepage.
copy.above_fold_note: Release data is populated from JSON now and XML as fallback. CI/manual builds emit both.

distribution.shared_hosting_mirror: downstream mirror for higher public traffic, not the canonical release authority

features.title: Manifest-driven landing page
features.summary: The homepage reads release metadata at runtime and fills version, dates, download URLs, hashes, status, features, and changelog.

features.title: Direct signed APK distribution
features.summary: The tester APK is distributed from the site while app-store distribution is not active.

features.title: Checksum verification
features.summary: The published SHA-256 is displayed beside the APK download so testers can confirm file integrity before installing.

features.title: SPV wallet recovery
features.summary: Import recovery, genesis birthday handling, and full balance discovery are under active repair and verification.

features.title: Explorer preliminary balance
features.summary: The app can display a provisional explorer balance for the visible receive address while local sync catches up. Full HD-wallet discovery remains a separate verification concern.

features.title: Local canonical deployment
features.summary: The local nginx-ui deployment is the canonical site. Shared hosting can mirror it later for traffic, but the local release root remains authoritative.

known_limitations: Do not use tester APKs for meaningful funds unless a release is explicitly marked production-ready.
Explorer preliminary balance is single-address and provisional until local wallet recovery is complete.
Manual builds and CI builds must emit this manifest shape; index.html must not be hand-edited for release data.

notes: Release manifest generated without a RELEASE_NOTES file.
